item.title: How the sample team reviews code
item.description: How do you review code when most of it is written quickly? On the sample team, once reviews were deep and coverage was high, we started measuring the smallest amount of reviewer time that doesn't raise reverts. This invented description runs past three hundred characters so the summary is cut at its limit and the full text stays in the content.
